rows.v: Tech (QQQ) in a downtrend, fear elevated.
QQQ has lagged SPY by 4.9 points over 20 sessions. Tech is the weak spot; the broad market is holding up better.
The previous note (Nov 23) covered a sharp rebound. Today QQQ gave back 1.99%, to 638.1 from 651.03, and SPY slipped 0.49%, to 718.78 from 722.29.

Toward buying: a QQQ close above 682.42 ends the tech downtrend and clears the market gate. Toward more caution: a QQQ close below 608.45 or an SPY close below 689.81 would set new one-month lows, meaning the decline would be continuing.
